Players Committee card image of [[Anakin's Lightsaber (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploy on Anakin, Luke, or Rey. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/anakinslightsaber.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/anakinslightsaber.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
